title: Two Sum (Indices)
statement:
Given a line of space-separated integers representing an array, and a second line containing a single integer target, print two space-separated 0-indexed indices i j (i < j) such that array[i] + array[j] == target. If multiple valid pairs exist, print the one with the smallest i, then smallest j. It is guaranteed exactly one valid answer exists.

Input format:
Line 1: space-separated integers (the array)
Line 2: a single integer (the target)

Output format:
Two space-separated integers: i j
notes: A real harness would also generate a large-input stress test (e.g. n=50000) to discriminate an O(n) hash-map solution from an O(n^2) brute force -- omitted here as a static file since it needs to be generated programmatically, not hardcoded. This is also exactly the kind of test a SYNTHESIZE_TEST_CASE action would produce mid-search.
